name: doc-control
description: Deterministic control of Word documents: addresses, tracked-change edits, live control of the Word you have open.
long_description: doc-control edits .docx files on your machine through stable addresses and anchors, with tracked-change batches, a dry run before every write and a safety layer that refuses unsafe edits. With Microsoft Word open, it can also drive the document you are working on. Everything runs locally; doc-control sends nothing off the machine, with one opt-in exception: if you switch on "Check for updates", it asks GitHub for the latest version at most once a day and only reports it. Off by default.

update_check.title: Check for updates
update_check.description: Once a day, ask GitHub whether a newer doc-control release exists and say so in server.capabilities and live.status. Never downloads or installs. Off by default: nothing leaves your machine.
